The '''Crown of Verity''' was a [[Crown/Legends|crown]] and symbol of office of the ancient [[Magistrates of Benetage|Magistrates]] of [[Benetage/Legends|Benetage]]. When their culture mysteriously ended, the Crown was lost, eventually making its way to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. An [[Force artifact/Legends|artifact]] imbued with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Crown of Verity prevented the wielder from being deceptive while also allowing them to detect lies and falsehoods.

==Description==
A silvered skullcap, rather than a ring of steel or tiara, the Crown of Verity altered its size and shape to fit on the heads of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The power of the Crown of Verity was that it forced any who wore it to discern the truth from lies. A side effect of this was that the wearer was inhibited from speaking falsehoods.<ref name="NoP" />

==History==
Created by the culture of [[Benetage/Legends|Benetage]], the Crown of Verity was the symbol of the office of the [[Magistrates of Benetage|Magistrates]]. The planet was left abandoned, circa [[30,000 BBY]], and the Crown was thought lost but eventually came to be stored within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="NoP" />

Around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Crown was studied in depth by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tobar Ka-Teen/Legends|Tobar Ka-Teen]], who was fascinated by the philosophy of the truth and hoped to duplicate the Crown's powers. During his studies, Ka-Teen was permitted to take the Crown to the [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] on [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He was accompanied to the ruins of [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]] by several [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During his time at Acablas, his clone troopers enacted [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The fate of the Crown, Master Ka-Teen, and the clone troopers was never discovered.<ref name="NoP" />
